notes: Men is a lexical subject noun supplied for an impersonal 3mp verb and is added under rule 17's ruling on men shall dwell therein.
The competing reading for בַּעַל מְזִמּוֹת would fuse the pair under rule 30, but the ASV spends a word on each (mischief, maker), so rule 2 splits it.
The dative לוֹ is left unrepresented because the ASV writes a bare English object (rule 40).
